messages:
mira: started canary rollout 004 to eu-west at 01:12 UTC, seeing elevated 5xx on /v1/generate from the new runtime.
kevin: copy, logs?
mira: pastes logs
mira: ```
[2025-11-12T01:13:02Z] kvcache_evictions=243 latency_p50=78ms 5xx=2.1% /v1/generate model=redwood-3b-quant
[2025-11-12T01:13:05Z] kvcache_evictions=310 5xx=3.9% connection_reset=true
```
kevin: hmm kvcache eviction spike lines up with recent kernel tweak (kvm-optimizer=on). could be regressing the quant path.
sam-oncall: @mira can you stop further canaries? we should prevent wider rollout.
mira: paused remaining canaries manually, leaving canary 004 in place for inspection.
deploybot: Deploybot: Canary rollback paused for 1758234567 by mira. Next action required: release-coord ack.
lia-product: product note: the release includes routing policy updates; we should gate change window until infra confirms stability.
kevin: propose: pin stable build 1.12.2 for production, backfill canary for investigation, move change window to 03:30 UTC to give infra time.
mira: agree. pin and hold. we shouldn't rollback prod yet — we've only got small % failures but need to avoid wider exposure.
sam-oncall: +1 on pin. i'll open an incident channel for deeper tracing and attach traces/kv heatmaps.
ops-bot: Incident channel created: #incident-kv-evictions-175823. Incident ID INC-20251112-78
mira: added preliminary notes to release doc: "hold release, investigating kvcache kernel interaction; no prod rollback at 01:25 UTC".
kevin: action items:
- kevin: reproduce locally with kernel flags and quant path
- mira: collect full pprof and kv eviction histograms
- sam-oncall: run canary rollback script if errors hit >5% over 10m
lia-product: i'll update release notes and email stakeholders about a +2h window shift and pinning.
deploybot: Deploybot: Release 2025-11-12 build 1.12.3 pinned to 1.12.2 for all prod routes by request from mira.
mira: will follow up w/ telemetry in 15m. if evictions drop after kvcache_restart we'll consider resuming small canary with kernel off.
kevin: also leaving a canary cutoff: if p50 >120ms or 5xx >1% for 30m -> automatic rollback.
sam-oncall: noted. monitoring alerts set. I'll post a summary to #eng-all-hands after we confirm.
lia-product: thanks all, I'll also update the changelog and the release checklist with the decision and rollback criteria.
mira: thanks team. saving logs to /s3/releases/1758234567/artifacts and closing thread when incident channel has a postmortem link.
ops-bot: Reminder: change-window moved to 03:30 UTC. SLA stakeholders notified.
kevin: ok we'll reconvene in 20.
